next.reason: §1985:VI.6.4.3 bars level 66, 77, 88 and USAGE INDEX in the description of D1 and D2 for every CORRESPONDING statement. 2023 states the D1/D2 restriction per statement: ADD and SUBTRACT keep the level-66 ban (§2023:14.9.2.3 SR6, §2023:14.9.44.3 SR6 'shall not be described with level-number 66'), but MOVE requires only 'Identifier-3 and identifier-4 shall specify group data items and shall not be reference-modified' (§2023:14.9.25.3 SR12), and a level-66 RENAMES ... THROUGH entry 'defines an alphanumeric group item' (§2023:13.18.45.4 GR2). MOVE CORRESPONDING naming a level-66 group, refused in 1985, is legal in 2023, and no 2023 rule bars a group described USAGE INDEX as D1/D2. 77 and 88 stay excluded because they cannot be group items. The requirement is looser.
